---
name: Capability work or defect
about: Propose scoped work or report a reproducible problem in a public demonstration
---

## Capability and desired behavior

Identify the demonstration, problem and expected outcome.

## Current evidence

Describe what you observed and how to reproduce it using synthetic inputs. Include the version or commit. Keep private logs, credentials and personal data out of this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

State what must work and how it will be verified. Separate static checks, deterministic execution, integration and live inference.

## Dependencies and boundaries

List prerequisites and what must remain disconnected or unchanged.

## Completion evidence

Link the relevant pull request and verification results before closing this work as complete.
